findings.conclusion: Actual empty versus present-undefined distinction, plain/Proxy brand rejection without output change, retained value after map/key retirement, poisoned guest methods and VM heap/Disallow gates, and actual ordinary/generic-fatal/private pending all exercise the intrinsic. Results that can carry an owned root retire through their real Fixture/locals; limits and execution permission restore before assertions.

Actual compiled Script identity/full source and real position projection are distinct from displayed names. A never-captured native Error can inherit; present disabled or formatted DATA blocks inheritance. Proxy is a traversal stop. Guest name/message/stack and WeakMap.get poison are not entered under the actual heap limit and pending modes. The independent Script owner remains after the Error/receiver graph retires.

Real captureAll native+Script frames and independently synthetic no-Script frames establish first actual Script selection. Proxy/accessor arrays and unsupported arguments return no projection without traps. The script/result owner is established before assertions; missing-source outputs remain unchanged.

recursiveCapture creates a real nested Error while the linked C hook is active; it does not write fallback fields itself. Presence is distinct from untouched Error even where the legacy reader returns undefined. Raw lookup neither adopts nor allocates. Successful actual map adoption consumes the C entitlement before formatter failure; failed actual VM allocation retains it and exact Script identity. Present undefined blocks inheritance until consuming transfer. Transfer preserves actual ordinary, generic fatal and private completion and the allocation occurrence count.

Fixture and Probe live at their final caller address. The Fixture owns installed owner/carrier/reasons/fallback through real cleanup; deinit disables finalizer actions, restores native gates, clears actual completion, uninstalls the actual hooks/accessors and frees roots before Engine teardown. Native Script and JS outcomes have independent retirement. The private event check republishes its actual token before cancellation; diagnostic DATA is not adopted.
